title: Myntra vs. Ajio vs. Official Brand Sites (Vero Moda, ALDO, Charles & Keith): Sizing & Authenticity
description: Aggregators are great for variety and markdowns, but current-season pieces, gifting, and hard-to-find sizes are often safer to buy direct from brand stores for fresher stock and complete packaging.

content_blocks.body: Choose Myntra or Ajio for multi-brand browsing, basics, and end-of-season discounts. Choose official brand stores (Vero Moda, ALDO, Charles & Keith) for current-season drops, gifting, precise size availability, and fresher warehouse stock with full packaging.

content_blocks.heading: Out-of-the-Box Insider Reality (What Other Sites Won't Tell You)
items: Marketplace return-cycle issue: popular sizes (e.g. UK 5–7 footwear, XS–M blazers) may arrive tried/returned multiple times, sometimes with crushed boxes or missing extras. For gifting or pristine pieces, brand-direct can be worth it.
Dust bags and accessories matter: check for included dust bags, straps, or care cards at delivery/unboxing—especially for handbags and premium footwear.
Return hygiene tip: keep tags, barcodes, and shoe boxes intact; test footwear indoors on a clean surface to avoid scuffs that can void exchanges.

content_blocks.heading: When a “great deal” arrives in a tired box
paragraphs: If you’ve ever received a handbag in a battered carton with a missing dust bag, you’ve seen the downside of high-velocity marketplace returns. For current-season fashion and gifts, where the item comes from can matter as much as the discount.

content_blocks.heading: How to choose the right channel
paragraphs: Use Myntra/Ajio for discovery, basics, and stacking sale prices. Use official stores when you need a specific size, the latest drop, or assured presentation. If authenticity and condition are top priorities, brand-direct is usually the calmer option.

content_blocks.heading: Policy comparison and when convenience wins
paragraphs: Marketplace: convenient app-based returns and discovery, but sizing/stock risk and packaging condition vary; keep tags/boxes intact.
Brand-direct: fresher stock and fuller packaging, but brand-specific return strictness and stricter condition requirements may apply; compare final payable including shipping before choosing.

items.q: Is it safer to buy branded fashion from official websites?
items.a: For current-season items, gifting, and hard-to-find sizes, official brand stores often provide fresher stock and consistent packaging. Aggregators can still be great for deals—just check seller/listing details and return policies.

items.q: Why do marketplace orders sometimes arrive without extras?
items.a: High return volumes can lead to packaging wear or missing non-essential extras in some cases. Inspect on delivery, keep proof, and use the platform’s return flow if something is missing or not as described.

items.q: How can I avoid return issues for shoes and bags?
items.a: Keep all tags, inserts, and boxes intact, and try shoes indoors on a clean surface. Review the return/exchange window and condition requirements before purchasing.

items.q: Which is better for sale prices: Myntra/Ajio or brand sites?
items.a: Myntra and Ajio often lead during large sale events, while brand sites run their own promos. Compare the final payable price including shipping and any member offers.
